findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: The wood present at the bar behind the hand sink and along the bar in various places is observed to be unsealed. Ensure a layer of paint or sealant is placed on the bare wood present to make the material smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe. P Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. C

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The external surfaces of the water gun are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil debris. This item is going to be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: The ice scoop was observed to be stored on a towel on top of the ice machine. THis item was washed, rinsed, and sanitized during the inspection and education was provided for proper scoop storage. Ice scoop may be stored in a clean container on top of the machine or it may be stored inside the ice machine with the handle above the ice. Ensure these practices continue to prevent contamination of the ice scoop.
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: The walk-in cooler floor as observed to be in need of repair as it is in a state of determination and not sealed properly. Ensure a plan gets in place for this surface to be repaired for it to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. This repair will be evaluated during the 2023 inspection.
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.citation_text: 750.830 Observed no thermometer in the dorm freezer underneath the bar. Provide thermometer.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.citation_text: 750.800 Observed what appeared to be mold on the ice deflector of the ice machine. Wash, rinse, and sanitize food contact surface.

findings.title: Personnel with Infections restricted
findings.citation_text: 750.500 During the inspection, only employee at facility was heard vomiting in the restroom by inspector. Inspector immediately notified employee that she needed to leave and get a replacement and should not work with symptoms of vomiting, fever, or diarrhea. Employee found someone to take her place at facility to CORRECT the violation. Inspector also notified employee to sanitize all surfaces with bleach in the restroom.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: 750.140a Observed no thermometer in the pizza freezer. Provide a thermometer for cooling unit.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
There was food leftover from a private party last night and condiments in the walk-in cooler.  All food inconsistent with the low risk permit issued to the bar was discarded to correct the violation.

750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: There was no thermometer for the pizza freezer.  Obtain a thermometer for the freezer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
There is a gap between the handsink behind the bar and the wall.  Seal the gap.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The pizza oven was soiled.  Wash, rinse, and sanitize the oven rack and drip tray.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment:
A dumpster lid was open.  It was closed to CORRECT the violation.

750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the bar 3-pan sink was moldy.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Clean the floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Wooden palettes in walkin cooler were damaged and/or rough in some areas. B) Rough wood was observed at the bar handsink. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Replace damaged palettes. Smooth out/seal other palettes. Paint all raw/rough wood surfaces throughout the bar.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 750.830g - (R) A chlorine test kit was not available during the inspection. Bartender was unsure as to whether or not the bar had a test kit. A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Obtain and use chlorine test strips to check sanitizer concentration and make sure it is at the proper concentration (50-100ppm chlorine). **All employees should  be trained on how to use test strips**

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment: 750.1130a  - Lid on right side of the dumpster was open. Also, garbage cans were observed by the front entrance and in the beer garden - they had refuse inside and were not covered. Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers. Close the dumpster lids after garbage has been placed inside, and provide lids for the garbage cans at the front entrance and the beer garden.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - (R) Back door to beer garden was propped open. Bartender had it open to bring in beer from the walkin cooler but it had not been closed. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of pests. The door may be temporarily propped open while carrying in products from the walkin cooler, but it must be immediately closed after employees are done. Bartender closed the door. **Self-closing, tight fitting screen doors need to be installed if you want to be able to have the outer doors propped open for any significant length of time.**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - A) Floor drain under 3 part sink at the bar was soiled w/ mold buildup. B) Back ledge of bar along the floor was soiled with dust buildup. Floors and drains shall  be kept clean. Clean the above areas.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 & 1220 - A) Hole was observed around pipe in the back wall of walkin cooler - insulation could be seen and a small amount of light from the outside was visible. B) Raw plywood was observed around the light fixtures in both restrooms. C) Fan cover in walkin cooler was soiled w/ dust buildup. Walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents. Seal the hole in the walkin cooler wall. Paint the plywood around the restroom light fixtures. Clean the fan cover in the walkin cooler.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.citation_text: 750.1240 - (R) Bulbs in the walkin cooler were not covered. All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of an establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.
